basic_info.description: This fully-detached Westlake Hills home is nested at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac street, in a prime, walkable area of Daly City. This ideal floor plan boasts living, dining, kitchen and three bedrooms all on the same level. An inviting formal living room with marble fireplace welcomes you, while parquet wood floors flow seamlessly into the bright, open dining area. This main level is complete with three spacious bedrooms plus charming full bath with shower & tub. Downstairs, the lower level is a great place to gather and entertain with a second living room, wet bar area with sink, full bath, and access to the large backyard! Plus, an additional 4th bedroom or excellent home office space. A huge yet very low maintenance backyard is the perfect place to host with extensive tiled patio, separate area to lounge, turf patch, a fruitful lemon tree & outdoor shed for storage. An oversized garage provides endless storage, plus a large workshop and laundry area. The home is bursting with curb appeal and a new front turf lawn with succulent garden! Situated just a few blocks from Westlake Shopping Center for ultra convenience yet only a few mins to SF and the world-famous Olympic Club, San Francisco Golf Club, Lake Merced, Fort Funston, and multiple other parks and beaches.
